blind.description: A stone crypt wall segment featuring three stacked rectangular burial niches. Inside each niche lies a wrapped corpse or mummy bundle in tan/beige wrappings, with the top bundle having a reddish-brown cloth or band around its middle. The wall is built of weathered dark greenish-grey stone blocks with a slightly projecting capstone and base trim. The back side is a solid stone brick wall. Surfaces are solid, manifold, and continuous, sitting flush and flat on the ground on its own base trim.
blind.from_above: A narrow, rectangular top surface of a dark stone wall cap divided into two blocks by a central seam, oriented vertically in the view.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.4 times taller than the figure (around 8 feet tall) and roughly half to two-thirds as wide as it is tall (about 4 to 5 feet wide).

notes: wall solid: w:h 0.54, depth:h 0.14, largest opening 75% x 1%, filled 94%
